title: World of Chewing Gum (WOC)
description: A collaborative full-stack web application built to compare and rate chewing gum products using an agile Scrum framework.
challenges: Collaborative agile coordination and synchronizing database models between Spring Boot and React.
futurePlans: Expand product categories and enhance user review filters.

title: Titocci Metalcostruzioni SAGL Website
description: A responsive client web platform engineered with custom interactive widgets, automated calculation tools, and modern styling.
challenges: Integrating complex Swiss canton calculation logic into responsive interactive sliders.
futurePlans: Add multi-language support and client testimonial management.

title: Carrosserie Örlike Web Presence
description: A responsive corporate web application for Carrosserie Örlike developed during a trial day at Netmaster AG, featuring social media popups, an interactive multi-language content dropdown, and an automated CI/CD pipeline.
features: Automated CI/CD deployment pipeline via GitHub Actions
challenges: Implementing a responsive multi-language interface and configuring an automated Docker/GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow within a tight trial day timeframe.
futurePlans: Add an interactive appointment booking form and a before-and-after repair gallery.

title: WISS Connect-Plattform for WISS-Trainees
description: An agile Scrum-based internship portal designed for WISS students, integrating token-based access controls and role-based security routing.
challenges: Implementing secure role-based access permissions and connecting local AI instances.
futurePlans: Expand company application tracking and automated interview scheduling.

title: Wiki.js Documentation Platform
description: A self-hosted personal documentation and knowledge management instance deployed on a containerized Kubernetes cluster.
features: Kubernetes cluster deployment via Helm charts
High availability on local Ubuntu infrastructure
challenges: Configuring persistent volume claims and Helm chart parameters inside a single-node Minikube environment.
futurePlans: Automate deployment backups and expand documentation categories.

title: Master Todo Mobile App
description: A native Android task management application featuring local database persistence, custom progress indicators, and emulator testing.
features: Local database persistence with Room DAO
challenges: Managing asynchronous local database operations and state transitions on Android emulators.
futurePlans: Add cloud synchronization and widget support.

title: Football Quiz Application
description: An interactive single-player football quiz featuring a robust REST API backend and a multi-language frontend.
features: Detailed tabular evaluation for knowledge gap analysis
challenges: Structuring score evaluation algorithms and rendering tabular statistics dynamically.
futurePlans: Introduce multiplayer mode and global leaderboards.

title: Microservices & Infrastructure Deployment
description: Deployment of enterprise microservices including Nextcloud and an internal MediaWiki instance using Docker on virtual machines with database administration via phpMyAdmin.
challenges: Configuring networking rules and persistent volumes across multiple containerized services.
futurePlans: Implement automated SSL certificates and centralized log monitoring.

title: MangaDB Library
description: A web-based full-stack application developed for Module 183 (Implementing Application Security) featuring multi-user management, secure user authentication, automatic salting, and BCrypt password hashing for organized manga libraries.
features: Secure password hashing with BCrypt & automatic unique salting
Key Stretching (configurable work factor) to mitigate brute-force attacks
Secure login verification via Spring Security
Protected frontend routing with Vite & React
challenges: Enforcing secure endpoint protection, implementing automatic salting, and managing key stretching parameters for BCrypt password verification without exposing plaintext credentials.
futurePlans: Add advanced bookmarking, chapter tracking features, and continuous security audits.

title: Glance Dashboard
description: A self-hosted containerized dashboard deployed in a local area network to monitor and visualize real-time telemetry data via widgets.
challenges: Configuring network endpoints and API widgets for smooth real-time telemetry monitoring.
futurePlans: Add custom alert thresholds and smart home integrations.

title: Wissquiz Testing & Enhancement
description: Refactoring and enhancement of an interactive quiz application with score evaluation, authentication context, and unit testing.
features: Unit testing with JUnit and Mockito
challenges: Writing mock services and ensuring comprehensive test coverage for backend controllers.

title: Miniclub(MINI) Website
description: A personal web platform implementation inspired by the design and structure of the 'MINI Electric Cars' webshop collection.
features: Custom CSS styling mirroring brand identity
challenges: Replicating exact high-end corporate styling and animations without external design frameworks.

title: Maestro Budget (E-Banking API Prototype)
description: A prototype of an e-banking API designed visually using interactive UI/UX wireframes and layout prototypes without code.
challenges: Translating complex banking workflows into intuitive, user-friendly visual prototypes.
futurePlans: Develop a functional backend implementation for the prototype.

title: Lift Mate-Ergonomic Ergonomic laptop stand(Innovation project)
description: LiftMate was developed as part of Module 245. The project entails the development and marketing of a wooden laptop stand, integrating product design, project management, and marketing. Furthermore, LiftMate was already utilized in Module 241—Initiating Innovative ICT Solutions.
challenges: Making a great marketing analysis, stakeholder and markt analysic and to find out which should be our target audience
